_comment: Real `ChargeResult` payloads for the off-chain conformance test.
`ChargeResult` is a Soroban `#[contracttype]` enum with no payload fields
(contract/src/batch.rs), so each element on the wire is an `scvU32`
carrying the variant discriminant — NOT an `scvSymbol`. The whole return
those, one element per input address, in input order.
The `single_xdr_base64` values are the base64 XDR of one `scvU32`; the
`xdr_base64` values are the base64 XDR of the whole `scvVec`.
See docs/charge-results.md for the full wire-format reference.

variants.name: Skipped
variants.meaning: Interval has not elapsed yet. Not an error.

variants.name: NoSubscription
variants.meaning: No subscription exists for this address.

variants.name: GracePeriodElapsed
variants.meaning: The charge window closed; the subscription is overdue beyond its grace period.

variants.name: AllowanceInsufficient
variants.meaning: Subscriber's token allowance is below the gross amount. The subscription stays active.

vectors.name: all_variants
vectors.description: One address per variant, in declaration order.

vectors.name: documented_example
vectors.description: The worked example from docs/charge-results.md: Charged, Skipped, AllowanceInsufficient.

vectors.name: all_charged
vectors.description: Every subscriber in the batch was charged.

vectors.name: all_failed
vectors.description: Every subscriber failed with the same outcome.

vectors.name: empty_batch
vectors.description: An empty batch: the vector is present but has no elements.

no_result.name: scvVoid
no_result.description: What an aborted invocation returns instead of a vector: no ChargeResult exists at all.
